scenarios.name: Retain compact appearance when switching tabs and cycling display modes

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
the user selects the Tools tab
its ribbon commands use the compact layout
the user cycles the ribbon through panel buttons, panel titles, and tabs only back to the full ribbon
the Tools ribbon commands still use the compact layout
the Ribbon Appearance submenu marks "Compact" as selected
